role: Mission Critical Networks Software Engineer - Summer 2027 Internship

jd:
We are rebuilding biotech for the AI era.

When a breakthrough is delayed, the world waits. Getting a molecule from discovery to patients, or a crop from lab to field, involves thousands of slow, manual, disconnected steps. AI has the potential to change this, compressing decades of R&D work into years. But that only happens when clean, structured scientific data and AI are built into how science gets done.

Benchling is the AI platform for biotech R&D. Scientists use Benchling to design experiments, capture structured data, and run AI agents and models directly in their workflows. Over 200,000 scientists around the world trust Benchling to power their most important work, from academic labs to Sanofi, Moderna, and more than half of the world's top 50 biopharma.

We’re building an AI scientist for our customers. We can’t do that if we haven’t built the muscle ourselves. AI fluency is the foundation we build on; it's core to how we work, and we're committed to helping every new hire integrate it into their day-to-day. As part of our interview process, you'll complete a brief AI-focused exercise or discussion so we can understand how you think about and use AI to drive impact in your role. Feel free to reference any tools, platforms, or workflows you use today.






ROLE OVERVIEW

We’re hiring interns to join us in San Francisco. As an intern at Benchling, you’ll have real ownership from day one—building, scaling, and shaping the systems that power our platform and products. Depending on your interests and background, you’ll join either our platform and infrastructure teams (driving scalability, reliability, and performance) or our product and application teams (delivering high-impact features that advance the future of life sciences R&D). You’ll work alongside experienced engineers and technical leads who are passionate about mentorship and engineering excellence—helping you grow rapidly as you make meaningful contributions to a product used by scientists around the world.




RESPONSIBILITIES

You will own a project end-to-end, from initial design, to prototype, to large-scale rollout. You might:

 - Design and implement backend models and API endpoints for complex scientific workflows.

 - Build and operate rich frontend components and visualizations.

 - Design and build a platform framework or infrastructure tool for other Benchling engineers to use.

Check out our University Recruiting page https://www.benchling.com/university-recruiting , https://benchling.engineering/ our engineering blog https://benchling.engineering and product overview https://www.benchling.com/product-overview for some examples of past work and current projects.




QUALIFICATIONS

  Must haves:

 - Current enrollment in a BS/MS degree in computer science and/or STEM fields with an expected graduation date between Dec 2027 and Summer 2028.

 - A prior software engineering internship or similar experience.

 - Strong abilities in problem solving and iterating on feedback.

 - A desire to have ownership over building key pieces of product and/or platform.

 - A product-first approach to building software. You ship code quickly and care about the real world impact of your code.

Nice to haves:

 - Passion for learning about life science.

 


HOW WE WORK

Interns are expected to be on-site 5 days per week.
